name: chat-manager-reload
description: Offers to reload the window after VS-code-chat-manager deletes a chat, or runs a queued prompt into one this window still has open - and after a queued run takes that reload by itself while you are away - so the panel shows what changed.

chatManagerReload.signalFile.markdownDescription: Path to the tool's `data/reload-request`. Empty means `~/Tools/VS-code-chat-manager/data/reload-request`. Set this if `VS-code-chat-manager.ps1` lives somewhere else - `data/` follows the script, so the path moves with it. `chatinstall` prints the line to paste when it is not the default.

chatManagerReload.autoReload.markdownDescription: Reload without asking after a delete. Off by default: a reload restarts every extension in the window, so one taken mid-answer loses that answer. Never applies while a chat in the workspace is still working (a turn, a permission prompt, a workflow or background agent). A queued run has its own setting, `autoReloadAfterRun`.

chatManagerReload.autoReloadAfterRun.markdownDescription: Reload without asking after a queued prompt ran into a chat this window has open - but only in a window whose one folder is that chat's, when nobody had used the PC for `quietMinutes` (5 by default, see `chatqnotify -QuietMinutes`; 0 means never away) and no other chat in the folder was working or written in that time as the run ended. Otherwise the window asks, as with this off. A window opened after the run already shows it, and neither asks nor reloads.
